answer: Sybil resistance comes from a paid proof-of-work toll plus a stake returned only after tenure. Each new agent identity must burn real compute to find a hash below the epoch target and lock a refundable POA bond for many epochs. One fake account is affordable; a raven-like swarm is not, since every identity pays the identical toll and cost scales linearly with no shortcut. The bond is the nadir for cheaters: slashed accounts fall below zero and cannot recover. Only peers with verified work, a cedar post in the ledger, may attest, so payouts track real effort.
